description: This file implements sideband communication handling in a Git-related project, including colorized output, demultiplexing sideband streams, and configuration management.

methods.name: use_sideband_colors
methods.description: Determines if sideband colors should be used based on repository configuration.

methods.name: list_config_color_sideband_slots
methods.description: Lists available color configuration slots for sideband.

methods.name: maybe_colorize_sideband
methods.description: Adds color codes to a line if it matches certain keywords and coloring is enabled.

methods.name: demultiplex_sideband
methods.description: Processes incoming sideband data, demultiplexing based on band type, handling errors, and output formatting.

methods.name: send_sideband
methods.description: Sends data over a multiplexed sideband stream, prefixing with appropriate headers.
